newsitem.title: CHINA: China collective firm asset-debt ratio 80.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: China collective firm asset-debt ratio 80.4 pct.

text.p: The asset-liability ratio of China's 13,000 collective enterprises is 80.4 percent according to a state survey, the China Securities said on Wednesday.

The Finance Ministry, the State Administration of Taxation and the State Economic and Trade Commission have checked assets of 13,000 collective firms in 28 provinces and cities since last July, the newspaper quoted Vice Finance Minister Zhang Youcai as saying.
The debt owed by the 13,000 enterprises to banks totalled 112.04 billion yuan ($13.49 billion) while the assets of the firms were 139.32 billion yuan, Zhang said.
China would expand the asset check on collective enterprises this year, he said but gave no further details.
